reason: In tests/sentry/api/helpers/test_error_upsampling.py:21, which the patch adds, the organization is created with Organization.objects.create(name="test-org") inside a TestCase subclass, even though self.create_organization is available. This goes against CLAUDE.md:627 ('Use `self.create_*` helpers, not direct model creation') and CLAUDE.md:322 ('Use factories for test data').
